title: BUG: 3.4.0 and Equil bolus delivery prompt dont close
body: In the latest version, the notification window doesn't close when a bolus is delivered. Insulin is delivered. You have to force close the app and restart it.

comments.body: I have issue like this with Medtrum Nano when i send bolus and put screen off when i return to my phone after few minute bolus not send  in the screen it's like stop and when screen on continu to delivery.

I have the same issue with Equil on the new version of AAPS 3.4.1.0. When I force restart the app, carbs are missing. I have to manually add them using "Carbs" button. Please help to solve this issue.
